about_the_game:
HackOS – Dive into the Ultimate Hacking Sandbox!

HackOS: The ultimate hacking MMO. Dive into a shared, ever-evolving world of espionage, dilemmas, competition & collaboration — all via your terminal. Inspired by classic hacking games and refined for modern players, HackOS combines the depth of simulation with the excitement of arcade gameplay.

Key Features:

  • Authentic Asynchronous Multiplayer: Hack alongside thousands in a persistent world—compete for resources, collaborate on massive ops, leave traces for rivals to discover, and watch your influence evolve the ecosystem in real-time.

  • Dynamic Persistent Sandbox: A living global digital realm shaped by player actions. Manipulate the stock market with real player-driven fluctuations, dominate the dark web marketplace, and trigger chain reactions that affect everyone.

  • Story-Driven Campaign with Faction Wars: Align with rival factions, tackle branching missions, and ignite global events like corporate takeovers or cyber wars—unravel the mysteries of Node Zero as player choices rewrite the narrative.

  • Diverse MMO Gameplay Systems: Build reputation across factions, trade crypto and tools on bustling player markets, invest strategically, form alliances or rivalries—every hack, trade, or sabotage has lasting, community-wide consequences. Optional solo mode available.

Whether you’re a lone wolf strategist, faction leader, or market manipulator, HackOS delivers an unparalleled persistent hacking MMO that tests your skills, strategies, and cunning against a global community.

Are you ready to log in?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 4100
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050TI
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5600G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
